headline:
August was a month defined by creativity and connection.

Across press, creator and events, we continued to help our clients create moments that felt personal and engaging. 

One of the month’s highlights was curating and delivering the launch event for Desenio’s new Little Artist, Big Dreams collection, where parents and children came together to explore the collection and enjoy activities created especially for the occasion. It was a celebration of creativity for the whole family, and a lovely reminder of how art can bring people of all ages together.

We were also proud to lead an incredible experience for TUMI at Cliveden House, celebrating the launch of their new collection. KOLs and press were invited to indulge in a stay designed around the brand, from bespoke activations to a beautiful afternoon tea and an exceptional dinner, each element offering the perfect backdrop for coverage and content that captured TUMI’s spirit of refined travel.

What connected both moments was a shared commitment to thoughtful detail and bringing the right people together to celebrate what our clients do best.

#tlaclients #luxury #pr #events
